perItemFindings.label: S5
perItemFindings.one_line: `RegularSubmodel` only stores `path`, `path_zero`, and an arbitrary mean-zero `score`; it contains no path-score/DQM/regularity relation. Thus it cannot soundly model the core's admissible semiparametric submodels or their tangent scores.

verbatim_critique: Re-plan S5 and the canonical-gradient theorem's use of `IsPathwiseGradient`/`IsTangentSpace`: define a local regular-submodel interface tying each score to its actual in-class law path (and DQM where required), then use projection packaging only if it can be restricted to that interface. As written, the library quantifies over constant paths paired with arbitrary mean-zero scores, so it cannot establish the intended canonical-gradient claim.
